text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened while I was taking a short 
break in the cafeteria...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hmm-hmm, hmm-hmm♪ Hmm-hmm-hmm-hmm-hmmm♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yup, cream looks good, height is perfect! 
This extra-large wedding cake is coming 
along great~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing right in front of Hishi Akebono 
was a towering wedding cake that was even 
taller than her already tall stature.
choice_data_list: Why did you make a wedding cake?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You see~, we're holding a wrap party for 
all the muses who ran in their wedding 
dresses~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
One thing led to another, and we hadn't 
gotten around to holding it yet~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Understanding the reason, what caught my 
eye next was the massive pile of cardboard 
boxes stacked next to the cake.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
These? They're Bing cherries~. They're my 
absolute favorite~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Big, firm, and super-sweeeet fruit! No 
matter how many I eat, I can never get 
enough~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And now~, we top the cake generously with 
them!
choice_data_list:
Even though they're your favorite, you're 
using them all?

They're your absolute favorite, but you're 
giving them away?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Of course♪ When something's delicious, you 
want to share it with everyone~.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Akebono-saaan! The muse members have 
arrived!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, okie-dokie! Thank you, 
Kawakami-chaaan!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Well then... you have to come eat some 
too~. I want to thank you for helping out 
at the ranch☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking her up on her kind offer, I decided 
to go join the feast.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Alright, everyone! Eat lots and lots of 
cake, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, absolutely exquiiiiisite!! This cake 
doesn't just look amazing, it tastes 
heavenly too~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, try the part with the cherries 
too! It's soooo delicious~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It is so fluffy and incredibly juicy! Have 
you all tried some yet?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Not the cherry part yet. Though just the 
sponge and cream alone are plenty 
delicious...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
In that case, you've definitely gotta try 
it~♪ I'll slice some for you right now~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah, thanks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh, quite an innocent look on your face, 
Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Eh, ah! Um, this is...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I understand completely. 
Given what a masterpiece this is.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad~. Sharing tasty food makes 
everyone happy and buono☆
choice_data_list: So that's why you shared the cherries too?
Is that why you shared your cherries?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yup! If eating cherries makes someone 
buono, then I want everyone to feel buono 
too☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Sharing with everyone makes everyone 
happy, and having happiness multiply like 
that is super-duper buono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: So, come on, you've gotta take a bite too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I took a big bite of the cake that was 
practically overflowing from the plate...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: How is it?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's a wonderful smile~! I got 
some buono from you too~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Now, now, eat pleeenty more♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Here, say aaaah! More and more, say aaaah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though a bit overwhelmed by Hishi Akebono 
continuously spoon-feeding me, I ended up 
having a thoroughly enjoyable time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as I was about to grab some cake...

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Hiiiii☆ My lovely little angels~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh~? Beauty Anshinzawa-san?

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a trèèès bien cake! The dark 
toppings add such an exhilarating accent. 
I can simply feel the inspiration 
overflowing!

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
...Buuut. You must not forget about 
*Beauty*, okaaaay?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: ...Got it~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After eating, the muses immediately dove 
into hard training to burn off the 
calories they had just consumed...
